title: Blue being gave physics to a construction worker
summary: Jesse Michels tells of Blue being gave physics to a construction worker, about unspecified at A bedroom, and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: I've had a past guest who was a construction worker and a blue being showed up in his bedroom and transmitted sophisticated physics principles to him and it put him on the radar of Eric Davis and Hell Putoff
